subfamily: served apart, never mixed: straight rye beside a cold pilsner (Oxford BOILERMAKER pdf 306-307: 'straight rye with a beer chaser'); the rye steeped with dried apricots and strained
glass: small stemmed glass (about 90 ml) for the rye, room temperature; tall pilsner glass (about 400 ml), chilled, for the beer
_status: v1 (Tomás, round 4). Two glasses, drunk alternately; numbers reported per glass and for the pair. No ice, no dilution (freeform fixed 0). Steep values are my estimate (unsourced); swept 0-8 g sugar and rye 40-50%.
